senses.gloss: काल- + अगुरु काल- + अगुरु, n. a black sort of Agallocum.
काल- + अङ्ग काल- + अङ्ग, adj. having a dark-blue blade, MBh. 4, 231.
काल- + अण्डज काल- + अण्डज, m. the Indian cuckoo.
काल- + अत्यय काल- + अत्यय, m. lapse of time, Man. 8, 145.
काल- + अनल काल- + अनल, m. the fire of all-destroying Time, Rām. 3, 69, 10.
काल- + अनुसारिन् काल- + अनुसारिन्, m, benzoin, Suśr. 2, 32, 1.
कल्प- + अन्त कल्प- + अन्त, m. the end of a Kalpa-period, the destruction, the end of the world, Dev. 1, 49; Hit. i, d. 43.
काल- + अन्तक काल- + अन्तक, m. the god of Death, Rām. 6, 67, 2.
काल- + उदक काल- + उदक, the name of a sea, Rām. 4, 40, 36.
काल- + कर्मन् काल- + कर्मन्, m. (?) death. Rām. 6, 72, 11. See कु-; कृत-, adj. one who has done his duty, Rām. 1, 66, 1.

† 1. कल् कल्, i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To sound.
 2. To count.

2. कल् कल् (akin to कृ), 1. 10, in three forms, कलय, कलापय, and कालय, Par. (कालय Ātm. Rām. 4, 18, 28): कलय,
 1. To impel, Kathās. 18, 90; कालय, to drive, MBh. 4, 1007, Bhāg. P. 3, 30, 1.
 कलित, Incited by, Śiś. 9, 59; greedy of, Rām. 5, 83, 10.
 --Comp.
 --With the prep. आ आ, कलय,
 1. To shake, [] MBh. 1, 2853.
 2. To catch, Śiś. 9, 72.
 3. To fasten, Kathās. 20, 52; Śiś. 9, 45.
 4. To surrender, Bhāg. P. 5, 20, 2.
 5. To regard, Prab. 5, 5.
 6. To perceive, Hit. 38, 10.
 --With प्रत्या प्रति-आ, कलय, To enumerate one by one, Daśak. in Chr. 185, 10.
 --With उद् उद्,
 I. कलय, To loosen, to deliver, Bhāg. P. 7, 8, 26; उत्कलित,
 1. Opened, Pañc. 184, 18 (where काल्˚ must be changed to कल्˚).
 2. Joyful, Bhāg. P. 7, 8, 34.
 II. कलापय, To beg for dismission, Pañc. 244, 25.
 --With परि परि,
 I. कालय, To pursue, MBh. 15, 1060.
 II. कलय, To reckon, Śiś. 8, 9. To perceive, Naiṣ. 2, 54.
 --With प्र प्र, कालय,
 1. To drive onwards, MBh. 1, 7178.
 2. To pursue, 3, 10778.
 --With सम् सम्, कालय,
 1. To drive, Hariv. 1191.
 2. To put to flight, MBh. 4, 1981.
 --Cf. Lat. celer, cello, procella; κέλλω, ὀκέλλω, κέλης, κέλομαι, κελεύω, κολετράω; O.H.G. halôn, holôn, holên.

† कल्ल् कल्ल्, i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To sound indistinctly.
 2. To be mute.
† काल् काल्, i. 10 (rather a denom. derived from the next), Par. To count time.

कलय कलय, To bear, Gīt. 1, 16.
 5. To perform, Bhartṛ. 3, 20.
 6. To put in, to fasten, Gīt. 12, 26.
 7. To utter, Gīt. 11, 9.
 8. To endow, Śiś. 9, 59.
 9. To reckon, Bhartṛ. 2, 37.
 10. To perceive, Śiś. 9, 83.
 11. To consider, Śiś. 9, 58.
 12. † To go: cf. उद्.

कलाय कलाय, m.
 1. Peas, MBh. 13, 5469.
 2. An unknown plant, Śiś. 13, 21.

कल कल,
 I. adj., f. ला,
 1. Dumb (ved.).
 2. Low, Brāhmaṇ. 3, 21; soft, Śāk. d. 85; Ṛt. 6, 29.
 कलम्, adv. Softly, Rām. 1, 19, 10.
 3. Indistinct, confused, Megh. 31.
 4. Uttering a low sound, Vikr. d. 119.
 II. m. A kind of Pitṛs or Manes, MBh. 2, 463.
 III. Often in compound words after अश्रु and वाष्प, adj. Indistinct on account of tears, Rām. 2, 106, 33; 2, 34, 53.
 वाष्प-कल + म्, adv. MBh. 3, 10839.
 वाष्प-कला, f. A torrent of tears, Bhāg. P. 3, 22, 55.
 --Comp.

कला कला, i. e. कॄ + अ, f.
 1. A small part, Man. 8, 36.
 2. A part, Man. 2, 86.
 3. The sixteenth part of the moon's disc, Hit. pr. d. 1.
 4. Interest on capital, Śiś. 9, 32 (at the same time, a sixteenth part of the moon's disc).
 5. A division of time, Man. 1, 64.
 6. One of the seven elements of the human body, as blood, etc., Suśr. 1, 326, 13.
 7. One of the sixty-four mechanical or elegant arts, Rām. 1, 9, 8; Daśak. in Chr. 180, 7; 9.
 --Comp.

1. काल काल, m.
 1. Due season, Man. 2, 80; instr. कालेन, In due season, Man. 9, 246.
 2. Time, Man. 1, 24; 7, 183; instr. कालेन, and abl. कालात्, In the long run, Pañc. 32, 24; Man. 8, 251; gen. दीर्घस्य कालस्य, After a long time, Nal. 18, 1; कस्य चित् कालस्य, After some time, Śāk. 110, 15.
 3. Mealtime; there are two meal-times a day, therefore, षष्ठ काल, The sixth meal-time = the evening of the third day, MBh. 13, 5175; Rām. 3, 31, 47.
 4. A period, Rājat. 5, 73.
 5. Death, Bhāg. P. 9, 9, 2.
 6. Time personified, fate, MBh. 13, 56; Rām. 6, 70, 35; endowed with the attributes of Yama, the regent of the dead, Rām. 1, 21, 13; 3, 35, 43, etc.
 --Comp.

2. काल काल (cf. कलङ्क),
 I. adj., f. ली, Dark blue, black, Rām. 6, 67, 2; MBh. 16, 57.
 II. m.
 1. A black and poisonous snake, Coluber naga, Lass. 16, 13.
 2. The black in the eye, Suśr. 2, 336, 20.
 3. A name of Rudra, Bhāg. P. 3, 12, 12.
 4. A proper name, Hariv. 189.
 5. The name of a mountain, Rām. 4, 44, 21.
 III. f. ला.
 1. The name of several plants, Suśr. 1, 131, 19, etc.
 2. A proper name, MBh. 1, 2520.
 3. The name of a female demon, Hariv. 11552.
 IV. f. ली.
 1. A name of Durgā, MBh. 4, 195.
 2. A surname of Satyāvatī, Chr. 6, 1.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. κελαινός, etc., under कलङ्क.

काला काला, m. 1. a kind of monkey, Rām. 6, 3, 35.
 2. the name of a fabulous people, MBh. 2, 1171.

कलकल कल-कल, m.
 1. A confused noise, Rām. 3, 34, 34.
 2. A name of Śiva, MBh. 12, 10378.

कलङ्क कलङ्क (probably an anomalous [] compound, कल-अङ्क), m.
 1. A spot, Rām. 6, 86, 42.
 2. The rust of iron, Ragh. 13, 15.
 3. Defamation, Pañc. 46, 3.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. काल; κελαινός, κηλίς, κηλάς; Lat. cāligo.

कलङ्कय कलङ्कय, a denom. derived from the last, Par. To disgrace, Daśak. 124, 1.
 कलङ्कित,
 1. Painted, Bhartṛ. 1, 9.
 2. Disgraced, Kathās. 12, 24.

कलत्र कलत्र, n. A wife, Bhartṛ. 2, 58.
 --Comp.

कलत्रवन्त् कलत्र + वन्त्, adj.
 1. Having a wife, Mṛcch. 67, 3.
 2. With his wives, Rājat. 5, 427.

कलत्रिन् कलत्रिन्, i. e. कलत्र + इन्, adj. Having a wife.
 वसुमत्या नृपाः कलत्रिणः, Kings are wedded to the earth, i. e. the earth is the wife of kings, Ragh. 8, 82.

कलधौत कल-धौत,
 I. n.
 1. Gold, Gīt. 8, 4.
 2. Silver, Śiś. 4, 41.
 II. adj. Golden, Rām. 3, 60, 12.

कलन कलन (cf. कलङ्क),
 I. n. A spot, Bhāg. P. 3, 31, 2.
 II. f. ना, Subjection, Ānandal. 29.
 III. As latter part of a comp., Bhartṛ. 3, 72, causing, perhaps to be corrected to करण.

कलभ कलभ (cf. करभ), m.
 1. A young elephant, Pañc. 159, 16.
 2. A young camel, Pañc. 229, 3.

कलम कलम, m. A kind of rice Rām. 5, 74, 11.
 --Cf. κάλαμος; Lat. calamus; O.H.G. halm; A.S. haelme.
कलविङ्क कलविङ्क, m. A sparrow, Man. 5, 12.

कलश कलश, or कलस कलस,
 I. m. (and f. शी, and n.), A water-pot, a cup, Pañc. 252, 10; i. d. 225; designation [] of the ocean when churned, MBh. 1, 1149.
 II. f. शी,
 1. A plant, Hemionitis cordifolia, Roxb., Suśr. 1, 139, 15.
 2. The name of a holy place, MBh. 3, 650.

कलह कलह, m. and n. Quarrel, MBh. 2, 1780.
 --Comp.
कलहंस कल-हंस, m., f. सी, A kind of duck or goose, Rām. 2, 82, 9; Kir. 5, 13; Ragh. 8, 58.
कलहाय कलहाय, a denom. derived from कलह by य, To quarrel, Pañc. 207, 22 (Par.).

कलाप कला-प (vb. 2. पा), m.
 1. A bundle, MBh. 3, 10772.
 2. A string, Kumāras. 1, 43 (of pearls).
 3. A band (of belts, laces, etc., worn by women round the waist). Ṛt. 3, 20; Bhartṛ. 1, 56.
 4. Totality, Bhāg. P. 9, 4, 21; perfection, Pañc. v. d. 23.
 5. A quiver, MBh. 3, 11454.
 6. A peacock's tail, Pañc. ii. d. 85.

कालाप कालाप, i. e.
 1. कलाप + अ, m. Hair, Śāntiś. 1, 27.
 2. कलापिन् + अ, m. A proper name, MBh. 2, 113.

कलापक कलाप + क, m.
 1. A string, MBh. 3, 10055.
 2. A band, Śiś. 9, 45.
कालापक कालाप + क, n. The name of a grammar, Kathās. 7, 13.
कलापवन्त् कलाप + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, MBh. 1, 1957 in ततायुध-, i. e. तत-आयुध- (vb. तन्), the aff. वन्त् belongs to the whole comp., Wearing a strung bow and a quiver.
कलापशस् कलाप + शस्, adv. (Made) into bundles, MBh. 13, 4509.

कलापिन् कलापिन्, i. e. कलाप + इन्,
 I. adj.
 1. Wearing a quiver, MBh. 4, 141 (the aff. इन् belongs to the whole comp.).
 2. With its tail spread out, MBh. 3, 11585 (a peacock).
 II. m.
 1. A peacock, Pañc. ii. d. 85.
 2. A proper name.
कलाभृत् कला-भृ + त्, m. An artist, Man. 2, 134.

कलावन्त् कला + वन्त्,
 I. m. The moon, Kumāras. 5, 71.
 II. f. वती, A proper name, Kathās. 9, 38.
कालवन्त् काल + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Long, Rām. 6, 22, 17.

कलि कलि, i. e. कॄ + इ, m.
 1. A die (ved.).
 2. The game at dice personified, Nal. 6, 14.
 3. The fourth age of the world, Man. 9, 302.
 4. Quarrel, MBh. 3, 12282; Hit. iii. d. 47.
 5. A very wicked king, MBh. 12, 361; 363.
 6. The name of an inferior deity, MBh. 1, 2552.
 7. A proper name, Chr. 297, 15 = Rigv. i. 112, 15.

कलिका कलिका, i. e. कला + क, f.
 1. The sixteenth part of the moon's disc, Bhartṛ. 3, 1.
 2. A bud, Ṛt. 6, 17.

1. कालिक कालिक, i. e. 1. काल + इक, adj.
 1. f. का, Referring to time, Bhāṣāp. 120.
 2. Seasonable, MBh. 3, 868.
 3. f. की, Long, Rām. 2, 41, 12.
 --Comp.

2. कालिका कालिका, i. e. 2. काल + क, f.
 1. A multitude of clouds, Ragh. 11, 15.
 2. The liver, Mit. 1, 31.
 3. A blood-vessel in the ear, Suśr. 1, 55, 1.
 4. The name of several plants, Suśr. 2, 499, 2.
 5. A name of Durgā, MBh. 2, 457.
 6. The name of a river, MBh. 3, 8134.
कलिङ्ग कलिङ्ग, m. pl. The name of a people and their country, Rām. 2, 71, 16.

कालिङ्ग कालिङ्ग, i. e. कलिङ्ग + अ,
 I. m.
 1. A prince of the Kaliṅgas, Ragh. 4, 40.
 2. pl. = Kaliṅga, a people, MBh. 8, 2066.
 II. f. गी, A princess of the Kaliṅgas, MBh. 1, 3775.

कलिन्द कलिन्द,
 I. m. The name of a mountain, on which the Yamunā rises, Gīt. 3, 2; Rām. 2, 71, 6.
 II. f. कलिन्दी, Rām. 2, 55, 4; 12; 13; it must be corrected to काल्˚.

कालिन्द कालिन्द, i. e. कलिन्द + अ,
 I. n. A water melon, Suśr. 1, 156, 21.
 II. f. दी.
 1. A proper name, Rām. 1, 70, 33.
 2. The Yamunā, Pañc. 25, 3.
 --Comp.

कलिल कलिल (vb. कॄ)
 I. adj., f. ला, Filled, MBh. 1, 3717.
 II. n. Confusion, Bhag. 2, 52.

कलुष कलुष (cf. कलङ्क and कल्मष),
 I. adj., f. षा.
 1. Turbid, Vikr. d. 8.
 2. Impure, Man. 10, 57.
 3. Choked, Śāk. d. 81.
 4. Unable, Ragh. 5, 64.
 II. n.
 1. Dirt, Ṛt. 3, 22.
 2. Impurity, Rām. 2, 97, 27.
कलुषाय कलुषाय, a denom. derived from the last by य, Ātm. To become turbid.

कलेवर कलेवर, n. The body, Bhag. 8, 5.
 --Comp.

कल्क कल्क, m. (and n.)
 1. Sediment, Yājñ. 1, 276.
 2. Paste, Daśak. in Chr. 199, 13.
 3. Foulness, MBh. 1, 268.
 --Comp.
ऽकल्कक -कल्क + क, a substitute for the last, when the latter part of comp. adj., अ- adj. Candid, MBh. 3, 4053.
कल्कन कल्कन (akin to कल्क), n. Fraud, Bhāg. P. 1, 14, 4.
कल्कि कल्कि (MBh. 3, 13111), and कल्किन् कल्किन् (MBh. 3, 13101), m. A name of Viṣṇu in his tenth or future avatāra.

कल्प कल्प, i. e. कॢप् + अ,
 I. adj., f. पा.
 1. Able, Bhāg. P. 1, 6, 7; with infin., 4, 13, 42.
 2. Being a match for, able to protect (with gen.), Bhāg. P. 8, 23, 22.
 II. m.
 1. A sacred precept, Man. 5, 74.
 2. A rule, Man. 3, 147.
 3. Performance, MBh. 13, 4728; usage, Daśak. in Chr. 189, 17; an act, Śāk. 99, 15.
 4. Manner, Man. 1, 112.
 5. The rules concerning rites, one of the six Vedāngas, Man. 2, 140.
 6. A designation of Viṣṇu as containing all the [] sacred precepts, MBh. 13, 953; of Śiva, 12, 10368.
 7. A day of Brahman, a period of 1000 yugas, the duration of the world, Bhāg. P. 3, 11, 23.
 8. Toxicology, Suśr. 1, 8, 5.
 --
 III. Comp.
 when the latter part of a comp. adj., f. पा, almost like, Rām. 1, 5, 21; 3, 52, 46.
 अ-, adj. unable, with loc., Bhāg. P. 7, 12, 23; with infin., 4, 3, 21.
 पुरा-, m. 1. a former creation, Man. 9, 227. 2. a tale of past ages.
 पूर्व-, m. time of old, MBh. 9, 2732.
 प्रथम-, m. a principal rule, Man. 11, 30.
 प्रसन्न- (vb. सद्), adj. almost quiet, Daśak. in Chr. 200, 6.
 यथा-कल्प + म्, adv. according to rule, Rām. 1, 11, 14.
कल्पक कल्प + क, m. Rite, MBh. 14, 1571.

कल्पन कल्पन, i. e. कॢप् + अन,
 I. n.
 1. Determination, Prab. 111, 8.
 2. Caparisoning or decorating an elephant, Daśak. 53, 13.
 3. Ornament, MBh. 13, 2784.
 II. f. ना.
 1. A rule, Man. 9, 116.
 2. Performance, Mṛcch. 47, 17.
 3. Making, Bhāg. P. 2, 5, 42; 4, 18, 32.
 4. Imagination.
 --Comp.
कल्पलतिका कल्पलतिका, i. e. कल्प-लता + क, f. A creeper yielding all wishes, Bhartṛ. 1, 89.

कल्मष कल्मष (cf. कलुष), m. and n.
 1. Dirt, sediment, Bhāg. P. 8, 7, 43.
 2. A spot, Rām. 2, 36, 27; Daśak. in Chr. 186, 9.
 3. Guilt, Man. 12, 104; sin, 12, 22.
 --Comp.

कल्माष कल्माष (cf. the last),
 I. adj., f. षी, Of a mixed or variegated [] colour, spotted, MBh. 2, 1043; Rām. 1, 52, 20.
 II. m. The name of a Nāga, MBh. 1, 1552.
 III. f. षी,
 1. A cow of variegated colour, Rām. 5, 13, 16.
 2. The name of a river, MBh. 2, 2575.
कल्माषपाद कल्माष-पाद, m. A proper name, Rām. 1, 70, 39.

कल्य कल्य (i. e. कृ + य, cf. कल्याण, of which the lingual ण् proves that the original form was कर्याण, cf. also καιρός)
 I. adj., f. या.
 1. Healthy, MBh. 2, 1974.
 2. Ready, MBh. 1, 865.
 II. n. Dawn, MBh. 1, 6304.
 III. कल्य + म्, adv. At break of day, MBh. 1, 6304.
 कल्यम्-कल्यम्, Every morning, Rām. 4, 44, 112.
 --Comp.
काल्य काल्य, i. e. कल्य + अ, n. Dawn, Rām. 2, 34, 34.
कल्यपाल कल्यपाल, see कल्प-पाल.

कल्यवर्त कल्यवर्त, m.
 1. कल्य-वृत् + अ, Breakfast.
 2. A trifle, Mṛcch. 34, 10.

कल्याण कल्याण (cf. कल्य),
 I. adj., f. (ना, and) णी.
 1. Prosperous, Nal. 12, 92.
 2. Blessed, Man. 8, 91; Nal. 8, 10.
 II. n.
 1. Prosperity, welfare, Man. 3, 60.
 2. A virtuous action, Rām. 2, 54, 29.
 3. An entertainment, Man. 8, 392.

कल्याणक कल्याण + क, adj., f. णिका.
 1. Prosperous, Rām. 6, 23, 7.
 2. Useful, excellent, Suśr. 2, 285, 3.
कल्याणिन् कल्याणिन्, i. e. कल्याण + इन्, adj. f. नी, Blessed, Kathās. 26, 49.
कल्लोल कल्लोल, i. e. कद्-लोल, m. A billow, Bhartṛ. 3, 37.
कल्लोलिनी कल्लोलिनी, i. e. कल्लोल + इन् + ई, f. A river, Prab. 73, 1.
कल्हण कल्हण, m. The name of the author of the Rājatarangiṇī.

कालक काल + क,
 I. m.
 1. The black in the eye, Suśr. 2, 304, 2.
 2. A sort of grain, Suśr. 1, 73, 5.
 3. The name of a Rākṣasa, or demon, Rām. 3, 29, 30; of an Asura, Hariv. 2286.
 II. f. का, The name of a female demon, MBh. 3, 12203.
 --Comp.
कालकञ्ज कालकञ्ज, m. The name of a Dānava tribe, MBh. 3, 12198.

कालकूट काल-कूट,
 I. m. and n. A kind of poison, MBh. 3, 540.
 II. m. The name of a people, MBh. 1, 4637.
कालज्ञ काल-ज्ञ (vb. ज्ञा), adj. Knowing the proper season, Man. 7, 217.
कालञ्जर कालञ्जर, m. The name of a range of mountains, MBh. 3, 8198.
कालतस् काल + तस्, adv. In the long run, Kathās. 6, 101.
कालता काल + ता, f. Seasonableness, Ghaṭ. 19.
कालपाशिक कालपाशिक, i. e. काल-पाश + इक, m. A hangman, Mudrār. 21, 1.
कालमाल कालमाल, i. e. काल-माला, m. A vegetable, Ocimum sanctum, Suśr. 1, 138, 16.
कालयाप कालयाप, i. e. काल-या, Caus., + अ, m. Procrastination, Hit. iii. d. 90.
कालानुसारिवा कालानुसारिवा, i. e. काल-अनुसारिन् + वा (fem. of व, i. e. mutilated वन्त्), f. Benzoin, Suśr. 2, 94, 21.
कालानुसार्य कालानुसार्य, i. e. काल-अनुसार + य, n. m. and f. या, Benzoin, Suśr. 2, 275, 16.
कालायस कालायस, i. e. काल-अयस् + अ, n. Iron, Rām. 5, 37, 38.
कालायसमय कालायस + मय, adj., f. यी, Of iron Rām. 5, 49, 32.
कालिङ्गक कालिङ्ग + क, m. A prince of the Kaliṅgas, MBh. 2, 1270.
कालिञ्जर कालिञ्जर, m. The name [] of a mountain, Kathās. 22, 161 (cf. कालञ्जर).
कालिदास कालिदास, i. e. कलि-दास (with इ shortened), m. A proper name, Śāk. 3, 12.
कालिमन् कालिमन्, i. e. 2. काल + इमन्, m. Blackness, Śiś. 4, 57.
कालिय कालिय, i. e. 2. काल + इय, m. The name of a Nāga, MBh. 1, 1551.
